objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document naming convention.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, Master data, or IT applications.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional information has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal submitted by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed independently from the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, triggering the out-of-force process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for assigning read or change authorizations and distribution to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that supports the processing of release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement tasks.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

attributes.name: current_step
attributes.description: Current step in the workflow process.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature applied by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the signature.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of User Groups and persons assigned to a document for notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A department or organizational entity to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered results about documents and their statuses.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status Report, Search, Acknowledgement Report).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Parameters and criteria used to filter report results.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the system automatically converts the document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process is initiated by the author or co-author, starting the 3-step release workflow.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects during the release workflow.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers in the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling it for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is officially released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes are made to content, attributes, or attachments.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the release cycle or version of the main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is removed from a document directly due to its non-critical nature.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document, notifying the document author by email.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal and marks it as completed.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser or release participants process the validity extension request via workflow, extending the valid until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the configured period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document, automatically starting the override workflow.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow by releaser or by initiator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request is processed via workflow by the initiator, restoring the document to a new version.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are restored with original metadata, authorizations, and distribution settings.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to a document by associating user groups and persons.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups and persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement notification.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document via workflow.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow-supported acknowledgement process.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is reviewed and released via workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: An evaluation report is generated with specific selection parameters and criteria to provide filtered results about documents.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, an archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a main Document and is released together with it.
Additional Information is a supplementary object added to a Document without being subject to its release cycle.
A Change Proposal belongs to a specific Document and proposes changes to it.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity needs to be checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to trigger its invalidation.
A Request for Reactivation selects a specific invalidated Document for reactivation.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notification and acknowledgement upon release.
A Document Template is associated with a document type and can be selected when creating a new Document.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document can reference another Document through the references attribute or local extension in multi-client systems.
A Distribution List contains User Groups that are assigned for notification or acknowledgement.
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups which determine their authorizations and role capabilities.
